shared_elements: horizontal register with a row of repeated short vertical strokes/marks along a base line
small animal figures (quadrupeds) rendered in profile
a wheeled/curved vehicle-like conveyance (chariot in A, boat in B) shown in strict profile
human presence indicated by repeated small figures/strokes
justification: Both show a profile conveyance along a base line with a row of repeated small human-like strokes above it (crew strokes in B, and a band of repeated pointed marks along A's lower edge), plus small profile quadrupeds in the upper field of B and horses in A. But A is a detailed naturalistic narrative relief of a horse-drawn chariot with modelled armed men, while B is a flat, wholly schematic linear outline boat with abstract stick crew, so the depicted subject, level of detail and pictorial conventions differ almost entirely.
